title: Pure Magikey
summary: Pure Magikey multi-Attribute Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz build featuring generic Level 4 Normal Monsters of various Attributes. The deck revolves around Magikey Maftea fusing or ritual summoning using materials directly from the Deck while a Normal Monster is on the field, scaling interruptions based on Attributes present in the graveyard.

summary.title: Starters
points: Magikey World searches a Magikey monster on activation and places Magikey Maftea on top of the Deck each turn.
Maginificent Magikey Mafteal grants an additional Normal Summon of a Magikey monster and revives a Level 4 or lower Normal Monster or Magikey monster from your GY.
Magikey Maftea serves as both Fusion Spell and Ritual Spell; if you control a Normal Monster, it can use one Normal Monster from your Deck as material.
Clavkiys, the Magikey Skyblaster provides the core DARK Normal Monster needed to unlock Magikey Maftea's Deck-dumping mechanic.

summary.title: Opening: Magikey World + Clavkiys
steps: Activate Magikey World to add Magikey Mechmusket - Batosbuster from Deck to hand, then use World to place Magikey Maftea on top of the Deck.
Normal Summon Clavkiys, the Magikey Skyblaster.

Activate Magikey Maftea (drawn or searched), using Clavkiys on field and a Level 4 Normal Monster of another Attribute (such as Alexandrite Dragon or Blazing Inpachi) from the Deck to Ritual Summon Magikey Mechmusket - Batosbuster.
Batosbuster triggers on Ritual Summon to search Magikey Unlocking or Magikey Duo from your Deck.
Normal Summon Maginificent Magikey Mafteal with its extra Normal Summon, revives Clavkiys from the GY, and Synchro Summon Magikey Fiend - Transfurlmine or overlay into Magikey Spirit - Vepartu.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Magikey Fiend - Transfurlmine can attack twice per Battle Phase, Sets a Magikey Spell/Trap from the Deck once per turn, and destroys an opponent's monster when they summon one sharing an Attribute with a monster in your GY.

Magikey Dragon - Andrabime prevents opponent card activations in response to its Fusion Summon, destroys all opponent monsters sharing an Attribute with materials used, and draws a card if two or more Attributes were used.

Magikey Deity - Ashtartu detaches an Xyz Material as a Quick Effect to banish an opponent's monster if they summon a monster sharing an Attribute with a monster in your GY or on field, and burns for its original ATK upon destroying a monster.
Magikey Beast - Ansyalabolas recovers Magikey Maftea from the GY on Fusion Summon and can change an opponent's monster's position and reduce its DEF to 0.
Magikey Mechmortar - Garesglasser can negate the activation of an opponent's monster effect and destroy it if you have that monster's Attribute in your GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Magikey Maftea is the flexible core Ritual and Fusion Spell that sends Normal Monsters directly from the Deck to the GY.
Magikey World searches combo pieces, stacks Maftea, and protects Normal Monsters from being destroyed by battle once per turn.

Magikey Unlocking negates an opponent's Spell or Trap Card activation and destroys it if you control a Magikey Ritual or Extra Deck monster, then declares an Attribute to lock opponent effects of that Attribute.
Magikey Locking revives Normal Monsters from the GY to immediately Synchro or Xyz Summon a Magikey monster.
Magikey Duo recovers a Normal Monster or Magikey from the GY, then optionally performs a Fusion or Ritual Summon.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Suship and Dogmatika hybrid engines are excluded in favor of running generic Level 4 Normal Monsters that cover all six Attributes for maximum Magikey disruption.
